objective: Larger profile portraits and taller vertical singer cards in the incubator list
layout: Desktop sidebar 300px; vertical cards with a full-width square portrait (~240px), name and two-line introduction below, status and version footer. Mobile uses one column, tablet two columns, desktop sidebar one column.
portraitFit: object-contain preserves the complete approved square portrait
accessibility: Singer name in button label, aria-pressed, selected check indicator and visible keyboard focus ring
scope: Incubator list presentation only; no storage, portrait normalization, profile fields or persona behavior changes
newTests: No new unit tests for cosmetic changes; isolated desktop and mobile browser visual QA
